# Tricot protocols

> Standard operating procedures for tricot on-farm trials, generated from ClimMob templates, with the questions of each protocol in five languages and a crop lookup that falls back to crop groups.

Read SKILL.md before answering. It routes a crop to its protocol and explains the question files.

## Core files

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-protocols/main/SKILL.md): how to find the protocol for a crop and answer which questions it uses
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-protocols/main/AGENTS.md): short instructions for AI agents
- [protocols.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-protocols/main/protocols.csv): registry of protocols, ClimMob templates and DOIs
- [data/crops.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-protocols/main/data/crops.csv): crops, aliases and crop groups
- [data/crop-groups.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-protocols/main/data/crop-groups.csv): crop groups and their default protocol
- [version.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-protocols/main/version.json): version and commit SHA of the current files

## Related

- [ai-ready-documentation](https://github.com/AgrDataSci/ai-ready-documentation): the Maniva suite entry point
- [tricot-knowledge-base](https://github.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-knowledge-base): the evidence behind the protocols
- [tricot-data](https://github.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-data): the data the protocols produced
